question: Under what condition does the act of applying meditation follow upon worship of the circle in this prescribed sequence?
premises: Worship of the circle must precede the application of meditation.
The duration of meditation is set by the correlative limit indicated here.
The prescribed practice links worship to sustained meditative application.
inference: Meditative application is to be undertaken for as long as the prescribed limit holds after worshipping the circle.
plain_english: Having worshipped this circle, one applies meditation for as long as the prescribed duration lasts.
